headline: СНОВА 12.
ПОМНЮ ВСЁ
tasks.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE professional YouTube thumbnail illustration, widescreen 16:9, ideally 1280x720 pixels, fully opaque PNG. This is a finished single frame, NOT a contact sheet.
Handmade layered matte colored-paper collage matching the attached approved Sasha references exactly. Every shape is cut from thick paper with visible natural paper fibers, irregular cut/torn edges, overlapping anatomy and clothes, very short soft contact shadows. Crisp readable large shapes, limited detail, expressive stylized faces with the exact reference identity. No continuous black outlines, no photographic skin, no 3D, painting, glossy surfaces, depth blur, film-grain overlay, vignette or comic effects.
This channel is 'Помнишь, как будет', story 'Кассеты', NOT a fighting story. Palette grouped into warm cream/kraft skin, deep desaturated teal/olive/brown, one restrained accent. Preserve natural warm paper skin. Do not add text, numbers, glyphs, writing, logos, watermarks, arrows, circles or question marks; ALL typography is added later in code.
Sasha identity: narrow angular face, small straight nose, big serious brown eyes with subtle tired shadows, pointed messy dark ash-brown paper hair and distinctive high cowlick. Do not change his identity into a round-faced boy or muscular fighter.
Truth: adult Sasha wakes up as his 12-year-old self in 2005 remembering his adult life; he records his fading memories of the future onto ordinary audio cassettes. The cassette is ordinary, not a magic glowing device. No supernatural beams, explosions, villains, riches or fake dangers.
Important: key details at least 5% from canvas edges. Keep lower right rectangle x=85%-100%, y=83%-100% quiet background only for timestamp.
INPUT REFERENCES: Image1 faces sheet: Sasha's EXACT facial identity; first top-left portrait is age12. Image2 ages sheet: youngest figure far left is the ONE boy to depict, not the lineup. Image3 bedroom scene: approved cream paper material, olive T-shirt, warm morning lighting. Do not reproduce the wide composition.
APPROACH A, EMOTION: tight chest-up close portrait of ONLY 12-year-old Sasha on the RIGHT half, occupying about 52% of image width. He has just woken up in his old childhood bedroom. Face very large, hair wholly inside frame, eyes widened with believable stunned recognition, brows slightly pinched, lips subtly parted, adult watchful gaze. ONE small child-sized hand raised naturally palm toward him at chest height, and he glances toward it as if realizing he is a child again. Anatomically correct fingers, no extra hands.
COMPOSITION: face centered x=74%, y=40%; silhouette from x=47% to91%, y=7% to91%. Main face should be luminous against darker muted teal-paper rounded bedroom-wall patch behind him. Left 45% remains clean warm cream paper, almost empty, for two enormous caption lines to be added later; leave x=5%..47%, y=12%..63% FREE of people and props. At lower LEFT only, a small blank wall calendar with a muted red #D92F2B top header, no dates/grid/text, on cream wall, hinting the year changed. Only calendar header is red. Minimal background: one simple out-of-focus-free warm paper hint of headboard low in frame, no patterned carpet or clutter. No bright shapes behind headline. Strong figure-ground separation, designed to read at150px.
